rationale: Both candidates independently rediscover the residual masked-varlen None-guard bug that mirrors RuixiangMa's ground-truth comment, but Y lands much closer to the human thread's actual center of mass — the CI-marker/lane concerns (yenuo26's 'please add mark', wtomin's skipif suggestion) and the 'tests silently pass without real validation' theme (RuixiangMa, yenuo26) — backed by concrete buildkite-yaml quotes and grep evidence rather than assertion. X reads as more thorough in volume but leans on suspiciously specific 'verified' artifacts (live HF Hub branch-SHA lookups, cold/warm load benchmarks on an L4) that this text-based review context has no way to have actually produced, which undercuts precision, and one of its flagged 'bugs' (major>=9 admitting Blackwell) contradicts the maintainer's own confirmed fix logic. Y's structured claim-verified/claim-refuted tracking and suggested-diff blocks make it both more grounded and more actionable.
